LOW_CountingHouse_Melee_Human
Cashguard Basher Humgoole, is a human member of the Cashguard located in The Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. He can be found patrolling the off-limits docks outside.
“
Shouldn't have bet the rent on that dice throw. What was I thinking?
„
— Humgoole
